grades.quote: demonstrate a program continuing to make use of an open file after all names for that file have been removed. You can remove the names using `rm` in a shell, rather than needing to write a program that uses `unlink` .
grades.reason: Exercise 8.10 describes the phenomenon the query asks about: a program keeps using an open file after all its names are removed. It also notes that this can be shown with rm, cat and tail. It only poses this as a task and does not explain the mechanism, such as open file references or link counts. Exercise 8.9 on hard links adds a little related context.
